New Employee onboarding

Task: New Employee Onboarding

Description:
Create a detailed onboarding plan for new employees to ensure they have a smooth transition into the company and feel supported during their first few weeks. The onboarding plan should include:

1. Welcome packet with company policies, benefits information, and a welcome note from the CEO
2. Introduction to team members and key stakeholders
3. Company culture and values training
4. IT setup and access to necessary tools and software
5. Orientation to the work environment, including office layout and amenities
6. Meeting with HR to discuss performance expectations and goals
7. Assignment of a mentor to provide guidance and support during the onboarding process
8. Scheduled check-ins with the manager to assess progress and address any concerns

Assignee: [HR Team]

Due date: [2 weeks after new hire starts]

Priority: High
